dialog.about.body.source: Explore stitch order, thread colors, jumps, trims, and machine commands before production. Preview the design stitch by stitch, switch rendering styles, and export what you see.
dialog.about.body.translation: Déan iniúchadh ar ord na ngreama, dathanna snáithe, léimeanna, gearrthacha, agus orduithe meaisín roimh tháirgeadh. Réamhamharc an dearadh greama ar ghreama, athraigh stíleanna rindreála, agus easportáil an rud a fheiceann tú.

dialog.about.tagline.source: Interactive embroidery simulation, inspection, and export.
dialog.about.tagline.translation: Insamhladh bróidnéireachta idirghníomhach, cigireacht, agus easportáil.

dialog.calibrate.info.source: Hold a ruler against the screen and drag the slider until the bar below is exactly 100 mm long, then press OK.
dialog.calibrate.info.translation: Coinnigh rialóir i gcoinne an scáileáin agus tarraing an sleamhnán go dtí go mbeidh an barra thíos 100 mm go díreach, ansin brúigh OK.

dialog.config.save_error.message.translation: Theip ar an gcumraíocht a shábháil: {error}

dialog.export.copy.tooltip.source: Copy the full-resolution image to the clipboard
dialog.export.copy.tooltip.translation: Cóipeáil an íomhá lán-réitigh go dtí an ghearrthaisce

dialog.export.save.tooltip.source: Save the image to a file

dialog.language.restart_message.source: The language has been set to {language}. Restart InkSim now to apply it?
dialog.language.restart_message.translation: Tá an teanga socraithe ar {language}. Atosaigh InkSim anois chun é a chur i bhfeidhm?

dialog.language.system_default_message.source: The system default language will be used. Restart InkSim now to apply it?
dialog.language.system_default_message.translation: Úsáidfear teanga réamhshocraithe an chórais. Atosaigh InkSim anois chun é a chur i bhfeidhm?

dialog.language.windows_closed.source: All open InkSim windows will be closed and the current file reopened.
dialog.language.windows_closed.translation: Dúnfar gach fuinneog oscailte de InkSim agus athoscailfear an comhad reatha.

dialog.open_browser.conversion_error.translation: Theip ar phróiseas réamhamhairc na bhfuaimeanna: {error}

dialog.open_browser.conversion_hint.source: See output.err for the error details.
dialog.open_browser.conversion_hint.translation: Féach ar output.err chun sonraí na hearráide a fheiceáil.

dialog.open_browser.conversion_timeout.translation: Chuaigh an réamhamharc fuála thar an teorainn ama.

dialog.open_browser.edit_hint.source: Open this SVG in a new Inkscape window.
dialog.open_browser.edit_hint.translation: Oscail an SVG seo i bhfuinneog nua Inkscape.

dialog.open_browser.empty.source: No supported files in this folder.
dialog.open_browser.empty.translation: Níl aon chomhaid a dtacaítear leo san fhillteán seo.

dialog.open_browser.file_read_failed.translation: Ní féidir an comhad seo a léamh: {error}

dialog.open_browser.folder_hint.source: Double-click the folder to browse its files.
dialog.open_browser.folder_hint.translation: Cliceáil faoi dhó ar an bhfillteán chun a chomhaid a bhrabhsáil.

dialog.open_browser.folder_open_hint.source: Double-click the folder to browse its files.
dialog.open_browser.folder_open_hint.translation: Cliceáil faoi dhó ar an bhfillteán chun a chomhaid a bhrabhsáil.

dialog.open_browser.inkscape_required.source: Inkscape is required to edit SVG files.
dialog.open_browser.inkscape_required.translation: Tá Inkscape riachtanach chun comhaid SVG a chur in eagar.

dialog.open_browser.inkstitch_required.source: A configured Ink/Stitch installation and Python launcher are required.
dialog.open_browser.inkstitch_required.translation: Tá suiteáil chumraithe de Ink/Stitch agus lainseálaí Python ag teastáil.

dialog.open_browser.invalid_folder.translation: Ní féidir rochtain a fháil ar an bhfillteán seo.

dialog.open_browser.not_embroidery.translation: Ní comhad bailí bróidnéireachta é seo

dialog.open_browser.preview_hint.source: Generate stitch data from this SVG with Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.
dialog.open_browser.preview_hint.translation: Gin sonraí fuála ón SVG seo le Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.

dialog.open_browser.preview_unavailable.source: Cannot run the active Ink/Stitch script or its configured Python launcher.
dialog.open_browser.preview_unavailable.translation: Ní féidir an script ghníomhach Ink/Stitch ná a lainseálaí Python cumraithe a rith.

dialog.open_browser.read_failed.translation: Ní féidir an fillteán seo a léamh: {error}

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_che.source: Ink/Stitch extension: could not check. Use Tools... to retry.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_che.translation: Síneadh Ink/Stitch: níorbh fhéidir é a sheiceáil. Úsáid Uirlisí... chun triail eile a bhaint as.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_mis.source: Ink/Stitch extension: not found in Inkscape's extension directories.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_mis.translation: Síneadh Ink/Stitch: níor aimsíodh é i bhfillteáin síntí Inkscape.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_no_.source: Ink/Stitch extension: cannot check until Inkscape is configured.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_no_.translation: Síneadh Ink/Stitch: ní féidir é a sheiceáil go dtí go mbeidh Inkscape cumraithe.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_unc.source: Ink/Stitch extension: not checked yet. Use Tools... to check.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_unc.translation: Síneadh Ink/Stitch: níor seiceáladh fós é. Úsáid Uirlisí... chun é a sheiceáil.

dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_needs_in.source: SVG source. Inkscape is required for stitch preview.
dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_needs_in.translation: Foinse SVG. Tá Inkscape riachtanach chun réamhamharc fuála a dhéanamh.

dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_ready.source: SVG source. Choose Preview to generate stitch data with Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.
dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_ready.translation: Foinse SVG. Roghnaigh Réamhamharc chun sonraí fuála a ghiniúint le Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.

dialog.open_browser.svg_invalid.source: The SVG could not be rendered.
dialog.open_browser.svg_invalid.translation: Níorbh fhéidir an SVG a rindreáil.

dialog.open_browser.svg_too_large.source: This SVG is too large to preview here.
dialog.open_browser.svg_too_large.translation: Tá an SVG seo rómhór le réamhamharc a dhéanamh air anseo.

dialog.open_browser.temp_file_failed.source: Could not create a temporary preview file: {error}
dialog.open_browser.temp_file_failed.translation: Níorbh fhéidir comhad réamhamhairc sealadach a chruthú: {error}

dialog.open_browser.unsupported.source: This file type cannot be opened in InkSim.
dialog.open_browser.unsupported.translation: Ní féidir an cineál comhaid seo a oscailt in InkSim.

integration.inkscape.config_save_failed.source: Could not save the Inkscape extension status: {error}
integration.inkscape.config_save_failed.translation: Níorbh fhéidir stádas shíneadh Inkscape a shábháil: {error}

integration.inkscape.inksim_none.source: No InkSim extension folders were found.
integration.inkscape.inksim_none.translation: Níor aimsíodh aon fhillteáin shínte InkSim.

integration.inkscape.inksim_scan_failed.source: Could not inspect Inkscape extension folders: {error}
integration.inkscape.inksim_scan_failed.translation: Níorbh fhéidir fillteáin shínte Inkscape a iniúchadh: {error}

integration.inkscape.inksim_user_current.translation: Síneadh reatha an úsáideora (sprioc suiteála/nuashonraithe): {path} | Stádas: {status}

integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.source: Could not install InkSim's Inkscape extensions: {error}
integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.translation: Níorbh fhéidir síntí Inkscape InkSim a shuiteáil: {error}

integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.source: InkSim's Inkscape extensions were installed or updated in {path}. Restart Inkscape to load them.
integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.translation: Suiteáladh nó nuashonraíodh síntí Inkscape InkSim in {path}. Atosaigh Inkscape chun iad a luchtú.

integration.inkscape.not_found.source: Inkscape was not found on the system path.
integration.inkscape.not_found.translation: Níor aimsíodh Inkscape i gcosán an chórais.

integration.inkscape.preferences_read_fa.translation: Níorbh fhéidir sainroghanna Inkscape a léamh: {error}

integration.inkscape.preferences_write_f.translation: Níorbh fhéidir sainroghanna Inkscape a nuashonrú: {error}

integration.inkscape.probe_failed.source: Could not read Inkscape extension directories: {error}
integration.inkscape.probe_failed.translation: Níorbh fhéidir fillteáin shínte Inkscape a léamh: {error}

integration.inkscape.probing.translation: Ag fanacht le freagra ó Inkscape…

integration.inkscape.python_interpreter_.source: Restart Inkscape to apply the new Python interpreter.
integration.inkscape.python_interpreter_.translation: Atosaigh Inkscape chun an t-ateangaire Python nua a chur i bhfeidhm.

integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.source: Could not remove the old InkSim extension folder: {error}
integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.translation: Níorbh fhéidir an seanfhillteán síneadh InkSim a bhaint: {error}

integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.source: Old InkSim extension folders were removed. Restart Inkscape to refresh its extension list.
integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.translation: Baineadh na seanfhillteáin shínte InkSim. Atosaigh Inkscape chun a liosta síntí a athnuachan.

integration.inkscape.report.config_save_.source: Could not save the InkSim configuration: {error}
integration.inkscape.report.config_save_.translation: Níorbh fhéidir cumraíocht InkSim a shábháil: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.config_saved.source: Saved the detected setup to the InkSim configuration.
integration.inkscape.report.config_saved.translation: Sábháladh an socrú aimsithe i gcumraíocht InkSim.

integration.inkscape.report.inksim_scan_.source: Could not inspect Inkscape extension folders: {error}
integration.inkscape.report.inksim_scan_.translation: Níorbh fhéidir fillteáin shínte Inkscape a iniúchadh: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.interpreter_.translation: Tá ateangaire Python cumraithe cheana féin: {path}

integration.inkscape.report.launcher_mis.source: Required launcher '{command}' was not found; the preference was left unchanged.
integration.inkscape.report.launcher_mis.translation: Níor aimsíodh an lainseálaí riachtanach '{command}'; níor athraíodh an sainrogha.

integration.inkscape.report.not_found.source: Inkscape was not found. Choose its executable to inspect the setup.
integration.inkscape.report.not_found.translation: Níor aimsíodh Inkscape. Roghnaigh a chomhad inrite chun an socrú a iniúchadh.

integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.source: Could not check or update the Python interpreter: {error}
integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.translation: Níorbh fhéidir an t-ateangaire Python a sheiceáil ná a nuashonrú: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.source: Python interpreter preference was not checked because the user extensions directory is unavailable.
integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.translation: Níor seiceáladh sainrogha an ateangaire Python toisc nach bhfuil fillteán síntí an úsáideora ar fáil.

integration.inkscape.report.restart.source: Restart Inkscape to apply the updated interpreter.
integration.inkscape.report.restart.translation: Atosaigh Inkscape chun an t-ateangaire nuashonraithe a chur i bhfeidhm.

integration.inkscape.report.timeout.source: Inkscape did not respond within {seconds} seconds.
integration.inkscape.report.timeout.translation: Níor fhreagair Inkscape laistigh de {seconds} soicind.

integration.inkscape.report.waiting.source: Choose an Inkscape executable to inspect.
integration.inkscape.report.waiting.translation: Roghnaigh comhad inrite Inkscape le hiniúchadh.

integration.inkscape.timeout.source: Inkscape did not respond within {seconds} seconds. Another Inkscape instance or an extension may be blocking communication. Close other Inkscape instances or disable the blocking extension, then try again.
integration.inkscape.timeout.translation: Níor fhreagair Inkscape laistigh de {seconds} soicind. Seans go bhfuil cumarsáid á cur ó mhaith ag ásc eile de Inkscape nó ag síneadh. Dún na áscanna eile de Inkscape nó díchumasaigh an síneadh atá ag cur bac air, ansin bain triail eile as.

integration.inkscape.uvr_missing.source: Required launcher '{command}' was not found. Install the uvr tool yourself with `uv tool install uvr`, then run this configuration again. InkSim will not install it.
integration.inkscape.uvr_missing.translation: Níor aimsíodh an lainseálaí riachtanach '{command}'. Suiteáil an uvr tool tú féin leis an ordú `uv tool install uvr`, ansin rith an chumraíocht seo arís. Ní shuiteálfaidh InkSim é.

menu.file.quit_all.translation: Scoir gach fuinneog agus an freastalaí

message.no_file_to_export.source: No embroidery file is loaded to export.
message.no_file_to_export.translation: Níl aon chomhad bróidnéireachta lódáilte le heasportáil.

message.save_error.message.translation: Theip ar an gcomhad a shábháil: {error}

status.line_settings.reset.source: Reset line width and shading factors
status.line_settings.reset.translation: Athshocraigh leithead líne agus fachtóirí scáthaithe

status.line_settings.tooltip.source: Click to adjust dark factor, light factor and line width
status.line_settings.tooltip.translation: Cliceáil chun fachtóir dorcha, fachtóir éadrom agus leithead líne a choigeartú

status.mode.bottom_view.source: Bottom view (draw later stitches under earlier ones)
status.mode.bottom_view.translation: Amharc bun (tarraing greama níos déanaí faoi na cinn níos luaithe)

status.mode.jump.source: Cycle jump display: off, all, risky only
status.mode.jump.translation: Timpeallaigh taispeáint léim: as, go léir, riosca amháin
